items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: I was picked as the piano player six nights a week, play with a trio and bring acts in that are traveling, you know Nick Brignola, Ernie Watts, do you remember?

ctx.x: Can you imagine what you would have had to pay a teacher to get that kind of stuff, and you still wouldn’t have got it anyway probably. The situation was just sort of perfect for you.

Right. So that was a big deal. And then I moved to the Rocky Mountains, to Colorado in the late 80s and right away got a gig at a club in Vail called Louie’s, which was this jazz club that wanted to happen. And then I was picked as the piano player six nights a week, play with a trio and bring acts in that are traveling, you know Nick Brignola, Ernie Watts, do you remember?
